title: Compact-gradient graph closure for Euclidean PI
source_anchor: §2.1.1, printed 48–49/PDF 60–61 compact inequalities and density discussion; Exercise 1.7, printed 43/PDF 55; August 20, 2026; PDF 8818e8fb40c07bd70651bafe10e8ec4500197c836928330b90025ca47da52fae
target_statement: On a finite-dimensional complete real Hilbert space E with its Borel structure, let μ be a probability measure and C>0 a fixed real. Suppose the homogeneous function LSI with coefficient 2C holds for every compact smooth real test. Let G be the scalar/vector L² pairs represented almost everywhere by a compact smooth g and its genuine gradient. Every (u,H) in the joint L² norm closure of G then satisfies Varμ(u) ≤ C ‖H‖²₂. This is a pairwise inequality and does not assert a single-valued gradient for arbitrary μ.
